news.title: UNI to host 2026 “Halloween House” for children and families
news.summary_en: University of Northern Iowa students will be performing Halloween-themed science demonstrations and supervising hands-on activities at this family-friendly event.

news.title: Premiere reading of UNI’s sesquicentennial poem on Oct. 29
news.summary_en: Over 150 years, many voices have echoed through the campus of the University of Northern Iowa. Now, a series of representative experiences are celebrated in an official UNI sesquicentennial poem, “Voices & Echoes” by Vince Gotera.
